description: Manually curated bilingual scholarly retrieval set. Each query has one unambiguous relevant passage and three hard negatives.

cases.query: 如何评估 claim-to-citation 引用忠实度

candidates.text: Citation fidelity is measured by checking whether every generated claim is entailed by its cited passage, with supported-claim precision and citation recall.
PDF typography includes margins, headings, line spacing, and page footers.
Vector databases persist dense embeddings and metadata filters.
A bibliography style controls author names and publication years.

cases.query: extract research methodology sample design and procedure

candidates.text: The Methods section describes participant sampling, controls, apparatus, variables, intervention procedure, and statistical analysis.
The conclusion restates the principal contribution and future work.
Reference entries contain DOI, year, journal, and author metadata.
Table captions should be placed above tables.

cases.query: identify study limitations and threats to validity

candidates.text: Limitations include selection bias, a small English-only corpus, possible label noise, and uncertain external validity.
The model achieved 91.2 percent accuracy on the benchmark.
The introduction motivates retrieval augmented generation.
The dataset license permits noncommercial use.

cases.query: find table reporting ablation experiment results

candidates.text: Table 3 reports the ablation: removing the reranker lowers citation accuracy from 92.1 to 81.4 percent.
Equation 2 defines normalized discounted cumulative gain.
Appendix A lists prompt templates.
The related-work section surveys prior systems.

cases.query: 公式定义 precision recall F1 harmonic mean

candidates.text: F1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall), the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
Table 1 lists the number of papers by venue.
The authors released source code on GitHub.
The abstract summarizes the research question.

cases.query: extract DOI and bibliographic reference metadata

candidates.text: References: Lewis et al. Retrieval-Augmented Generation. NeurIPS 2020. doi:10.5555/3495724.3496517.
Results show an improvement on two datasets.
The method uses a cross encoder reranker.
A chart uses blue and orange bars.
Paper A reports the intervention improves accuracy by 20 percent, while Paper B reports no improvement under the same outcome and population.

cases.query: verified open access full text PDF download

candidates.text: Resolve the DOI through an open-access registry, verify the public HTTPS PDF URL, content type, PDF magic bytes, size, and checksum before ingestion.
Sort search results alphabetically by title.
Copy any URL returned by a search engine directly to disk.
Use a browser bookmark to save the journal landing page.

cases.query: cross encoder reranker improves top one evidence ranking

candidates.text: A cross-encoder jointly scores each query-passage pair and reranks retrieved candidates to improve top-one evidence precision.
A dense encoder independently maps text into vectors.
BM25 counts term frequency and inverse document frequency.
Chunk overlap preserves context at page boundaries.

cases.query: 页码 chunk 可追溯引用格式

candidates.text: Each evidence item carries a stable citation such as doc:42#page=7&chunk=2 so users can trace the answer to the original page and chunk.
The upload directory stores files by checksum.
The report title is generated from the file name.
Markdown headings create an outline.

cases.query: unsupported claims evidence gate blocks report

candidates.text: The evidence gate marks unsupported claims for revision and releases a report only when at least 90 percent of claims have adequate citations.
The report can be exported to an Obsidian vault.
A project board tracks task status.
The system uses a dark user interface.

cases.query: 实验数据集 baseline metric statistical significance

candidates.text: The experiment section specifies datasets, baselines, metrics, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, and reproducibility artifacts.
The paper title is centered on the first page.
The knowledge graph links authors to papers.
The download cache expires after six hours.
